title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36545v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visual transformations at different temporal scales. This motivates us to model conditional generation through input-adaptive virtual temporal relations. We propose FrameForge, which captures two complementary aspects of such relations. Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) models how far the target lies from the condition by dynamically selecting temporal RoPE experts with different virtual intervals. translated_title: FrameForge：利用视频基础模型的先验实现统一图像生成
translated_abstract: 统一条件图像生成要求单一模型在保留视觉输入不同方面特征的同时，生成遵循文本指导的目标图像。预训练视频模型通过编码跨时间的视觉变换，为此提供了有前景的基础，然而现有方法通常将条件与目标固定在特定的时间位置上。我们观察到，条件与目标之间的关系在不同生成任务中差异显著，而视频模型天然地在不同的时间尺度上编码视觉变换。这启发我们通过输入自适应的虚拟时间关系来建模条件生成。我们提出FrameForge，它捕捉此类关系的两个互补方面：时间专家混合通过动态选择具有不同虚拟区间的时间RoPE专家，来建模目标与条件之间的距离远近；时间推理链则建模……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: FrameForge利用视频基础模型的时间先验，通过输入自适应的虚拟时间关系——MoTE（动态选择时间RoPE专家以建模条件与目标的距离）和CoTR（时间推理链）——实现统一的条件图像生成。
